points.description: Gives one valid limitation of AJM from the model answer: low material removal rate (MRR), limited nozzle life, or high cost. Equivalent wording earns the mark (e.g. 'slow material removal' for low MRR, 'nozzle wears out quickly' for limited nozzle life, 'expensive' for high cost).

Gives a second, different valid limitation from the same list (low MRR, limited nozzle life, or high cost). Repeating the limitation given in P1, or giving a limitation not in the list, earns no mark. Equivalent wording is accepted.
